I suggest swapping Triceps Pushdown for Low-to-High Cable Fly. It keeps the elbow in a fixed, slightly bent position, so it puts little stress on the joint. Tap Swap on the card to make the change.

⚠️ Keep the weight light and stay pain-free. Cut the load on your presses too if they bother the elbow. If the pain is sharp or doesn't go away, stop and see a professional.
